title: feat(electron): i18n for renderer UI driven by language setting

issue_comments.body:
@MaLunan thanks for the contribution. I reviewed this PR against the repository contribution rules and current Electron demo architecture. The overall direction is reasonable, but we will close this PR for now and ask for a follow-up PR with the required process and tests.

What looks good:

- The change is scoped to `apps/electron-demo/src/renderer/*` and does not pollute `packages/core` or the framework packages.
- The lightweight `setUiLocale` / `t` / `subscribeLocale` runtime is simple and avoids adding a heavy i18n dependency.
- Keeping renderer UI localization inside the Electron demo layer generally matches the project architecture.

What needs to be addressed before merging:

- This is a new renderer UI capability, so it should either link an OpenSpec proposal or clearly explain why this demo-only change can skip OpenSpec.
- The PR body still contains template placeholders and some checklist items appear inaccurate. Please fill in Summary / Motivation / Changes / Testing with concrete details.
- Please add focused tests for the i18n runtime, especially locale fallback, placeholder interpolation, and subscribe/unsubscribe behavior.
- Please clarify the semantics of the `language` setting: whether it controls UI locale, document/page language, or both.
- The PR adds many languages at once. Please either document translation source/maintenance strategy, or start with a smaller language set such as `en` + `zh-CN`.

Closing this PR for now to keep the review queue clean. A smaller follow-up PR with the above items addressed should be much easier to review and merge.
Closing for now as discussed in the review comment above. Please resubmit with OpenSpec/skip rationale, completed PR description, and focused i18n runtime tests.
